wines.name: Tignanello
wines.description: The first Sangiovese to be aged in barriques, the first contemporary red wine blended with untraditional varieties (Cabernet), and one of the first red wines in Chianti Classico made without white grapes.
wines.story_text: First produced in 1970 from a single vineyard parcel as "Chianti Classico Riserva Vigneto Tignanello"; in 1971 it became a Tuscan red table wine named Tignanello. Bottled only in favorable vintages.
